title: epicampes clomena
intro: Epicampes clomena, commonly known as the African boxwood or African boxwood tree, is a plant species native to tropical Africa, characterized by its small, yellowish flowers and hard, brown wood. Research has shown that the plant has various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Epicampes clomena include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
